archetypes.name: state-seeder
archetypes.rationale: Initial ship state now has create-if-absent semantics and many durable inputs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new ship seed-initial-state Python command and shell wrapper. Focus on create-if-absent behavior, manifest validation, key ordering, boolean defaults, and Step 5 stall overrides. Check that seeded state cannot clobber driver-progressed state and that missing durable inputs fail closed where intended. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: step8-routing
archetypes.rationale: Step 8 orchestration now splits pre-driver and post-driver paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 8 SKILL.md changes and wrapper call graph. Focus on pre-driver versus post-driver classification, OOS filing re-entry, guard ordering, and phantom-probe stdout isolation. Verify the docs and tests agree about when the seeder and oos file hook run. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
